title: E-Scooters Look Convenient—ER Visits Rose 260%
hook: E-scooter ER visits climbed 260% in just two years.
closing: Fast adoption needs helmets and streets that protect riders just as quickly.
question: Would you wear a helmet?

segments.say: E-scooter ER visits reached 27,700. A convenience boom became a fast-growing injury problem.
67% of young riders with head injuries wore no helmet. Basic protection was missing for most.
Cumulative e-scooter ER visits reached 169,300. The injury wave continued long after the first spike.
